## Endpoints

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /front/v8/elastic/plugins/{pluginId}` — Retrieve details for a specific plugin.
- `GET /header-api/icms/api/ui/pages/welcome-common-page` — Get data for the welcome page.
- `GET /header-api/newplatform/display/display/v1/item/content/area/PK011/{PK011Id}` — Get content for display area PK011.
- `GET /header-api/newplatform/display/display/v1/item/content/area/PK015/{PK015Id}` — Get content for display area PK015.
- `GET /nac/2` — Retrieve data from NAC endpoint 2.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /b` — Post data to endpoint /b.
- `POST /front/v8/elastic/plugins/{pluginId}/boot` — Boot a specific plugin.

### Search (1)
- `GET /search/main/v2/placeholder` — Get search placeholder text.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /front/v8/channels/{channelId}/events` — Send event data to a specific channel.

- Access Sky Interpark data without official API access
- Automate actions on sky.interpark.com (faster than browser automation)
